material.text: SPY, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.

material.head: Quiet selling on the dip
material.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 28% below its 50-day average: profit-taking, not an exit.
material.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.
